name: client-ledger
description: Admin-only client ledger: Express + Prisma API and Next.js web app.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci && node scripts/init-env.mjs
scripts.api:sync: npm --prefix apps/api run openapi:export && npm --prefix apps/web run api:types
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix apps/api run lint:fix && npm --prefix apps/web run lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/web test
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix apps/api run test:all && npm --prefix apps/web test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix apps/api run test:coverage && npm --prefix apps/web run test:coverage
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
